PR (cited in the notes as #22204): fix: Notifications on-deployed would now be delivered if sync didn't change the health status of the app in a process (#22203) [closed; labels ready-for-review]
Closes #22203

If the sync only included resources without health status like config maps, the transition time would be before than sync finish time and thus notification won't be sent. This adds a check that if transition time was before the start time, we consider it a successful deploy.
